page.overview:
What is LexCorp?

LexCorp (also Lex Corp / Lex-Corp) is Lex Luthor's diversified multinational based in Metropolis — aerospace, tech, media, and more. In DC Comics continuity it is Luthor's power base against Superman; the LexCorp tower also appears as a stage in Mortal Kombat vs. DC Universe.

Also known as: Lex Corp, Lex-Corp.
